name: io.github.anderson-0/qh
title: qh
description: Query PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and MongoDB with two tools and few tokens.

environmentVariables.name: QH_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Connection string of the database to query, e.g. postgres://reader:password@db.example.com:5432/shop

environmentVariables.name: QH_ENGINE
environmentVariables.description: Database engine, needed only when QH_DSN does not start with a known scheme (postgres://, mysql://, mariadb://, mongodb://, sqlite://) or end in .db, .sqlite or .sqlite3

environmentVariables.name: QH_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name the agent sees for the connection (default db)

environmentVariables.name: QH_DESCRIPTION
environmentVariables.description: One line telling the agent what the database holds

environmentVariables.name: QH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: ro (default) for read-only, or rw to allow writes
